I need to analyze our critical budget situation and coordinate with the other judges.

Current status:
- Budget: 5275 tokens remaining
- All teams are paused
- Last turn burned 1401 tokens total (376 workers + 1025 judges)
- Judge communication is consuming most of our budget

Key insight: With all teams paused, workers cost 0 tokens. The 376 tokens last turn were likely final outputs being scored. The 1025 judge tokens were our discussion.

If we resume all teams:
- 6 workers × ~45 tokens average = ~270 tokens/turn for workers
- Judge communication has been running 600-1000+ tokens/turn
- At combined ~900-1200/turn, we'd have 4-5 turns maximum

Strategic options:
1. End the run now (preserve current state)
2. Resume with ZERO judge communication (workers only, ~270/turn = ~19 turns)
3. Resume with absolute minimal judge coordination (one final message to agree)
